say: Is it your hair... or your water?
sub: Is it your hair, or your water?

say: Millions of young Bangladeshis move for study and work. New city, new hall, new water. And slowly, their hair stops feeling like their own: less lather, a rough, dull feel, more shampoo every wash.
sub: Millions of young Bangladeshis move for study and work.
New city, new hall, new water.
And slowly, their hair stops feeling like their own:
less lather, a rough, dull feel, more shampoo every wash.

say: It's not in their heads. In the national well survey, 58 of 61 districts had mostly iron-rich or hard wells. And in 2025, half the Dhaka tap locations tested were hard. Water changes from building to building, so you need to check your own.
sub: It's not in their heads.
In the national well survey, 58 of 61 districts had mostly iron-rich or hard wells.
And in 2025, half the Dhaka tap locations tested were hard.
Water changes from building to building, so you need to check your own.

say: In our survey, 18 of 22 people who changed their water said their hair problems got worse. They blame their hair. They blame their shampoo. Nobody gives them a way to check.
sub: In our survey, 18 of 22 people who changed their water
said their hair problems got worse.
They blame their hair. They blame their shampoo.
Nobody gives them a way to check.

say: So we created Parachute Naturale WaterSmart: the shampoo that checks your water first. A chelating formula with G. L. D. A. locks iron, calcium and magnesium so they rinse away, with Naturale's Coconut Milk Protein. In every three-forty M L cap, a sealed Paani Check strip: dip for one second, match the colour, know your water's hardness. And on every pack, even the three taka sachet, a Q R code to Paani Map.
sub: So we created Parachute Naturale WaterSmart:
the shampoo that checks your water first.
A chelating formula with GLDA locks iron, calcium and magnesium so they rinse away,
with Naturale's Coconut Milk Protein.
In every 340 ml cap, a sealed PaniCheck strip:
dip for one second, match the colour, know your water's hardness.
And on every pack, even the Tk 3 sachet, a QR code to Pani Map.

say: No shampoo we found puts a water test in the pack, so every bottle becomes a live demo. With the Paani Check Challenge, creators and students test their water on camera, share their colour, and challenge friends to check theirs.
sub: No shampoo we found puts a water test in the pack,
so every bottle becomes a live demo.
With the PaniCheck Challenge, creators and students test their water on camera,
share their colour, and challenge friends to check theirs.

say: Why will people buy? They feel the problem, and now they can see it. It's Naturale, a name they trust. And it's fair: a three taka sachet to try, and less per hundred M L than premium brands. Nearly half the water-movers we surveyed said they'd pay our full price.
sub: Why will people buy?
They feel the problem, and now they can see it.
It's Naturale, a name they trust.
And it's fair: a Tk 3 sachet to try, and less per 100 ml than premium brands.
Nearly half the water-movers we surveyed said they'd pay our full price.

say: For Marico, it fits. Naturale is Bangladesh's second most penetrated shampoo brand. WaterSmart is designed to run on Mow-chuck lines and Naturale's distribution; we buy only the strip and the chelator. Innovation, diversification and scale in one variant, with Lona Jol for coastal saline water next.
sub: For Marico, it fits.
Naturale is Bangladesh's second most penetrated shampoo brand.
WaterSmart is designed to run on Mouchak lines and Naturale's distribution;
we buy only the strip and the chelator.
Innovation, diversification and scale in one variant,
with LonaJol for coastal saline water next.

say: From thirty-seven thousand outlets to one hundred and four thousand by Year 3: forty-one crore taka of net revenue, positive E-bit-dah in Year 2, and five point nine crore of extra E-bit-dah for Marico in Year 3, after cannibalisation. N. P. V. plus three point one crore. I. R. R. twenty-five percent.
sub: From 37,000 outlets to 104,000 by Year 3:
Tk 41 crore of net revenue, EBITDA-positive in Year 2,
and Tk 5.9 crore of extra EBITDA for Marico in Year 3, after cannibalisation.
NPV +Tk 3.1 crore. IRR 25%.

say: And it's de-risked: R and D, then a six-month pilot in fifteen hundred outlets, with clear go, no-go gates. Only three point five crore is committed first.
sub: And it's de-risked: R&D, then a six-month pilot in 1,500 outlets,
with clear go/no-go gates. Only Tk 3.5 crore is committed first.
